rationale: WT YAP lentiviral control; promoted as paired control for YAP5SA — the 100x CFTR+ lineage enrichment in YAP5SA is only interpretable relative to this matched lentiviral baseline; technically clean epi projection (off-target 1.8%, ambiguity 11.2%, alignment 0.744); note: WT-YAP is a lentiviral control, not an untransduced control — Tip cells enrichment (29.9%) distinguishes it from untransduced GSE221343 CK+DCI

YAP5SA constitutively active nuclear YAP perturbation; promoted as paired perturbation arm with WT-YAP — shows 100x SOX2lowCFTR+ enrichment (5.6% vs 0.06%) and 100x NKX2-1+SOX9+CFTR+ enrichment (7.3% vs 0.07%) relative to lentiviral control; directionally consistent with P-0001 but SOX2lowCFTR+ is not the top state (partial shift, not identity conversion); P-0001 remains registered/supportive, not confirmed
